title: MC06
description: A plugin that brings gem features from sonic 06-p06
body:
The gem mechanics from Sonic '06 and Project 06 (P-06) served as major inspiration for this plugin.
Texture pack suggested: (https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/mcs06-texture-pack)
Eight distinct, physics-defying Gems are added to Minecraft by this plugin. Use telekinesis, time manipulation, extreme speed, and aerodynamics to your advantage to dominate battle and explore your world in a way never seen before. As you advance through each Gem's full 4-tier Progression System (Level 0 to Level 3), you'll be able to access new skills and passive benefits!

here is a youtube video explaining how it works https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tDDr1B6H0n4
